description: Web search as a pluggable, Settings-configurable feature gated behind the composer 🌐 toggle. When ON, the app runs a web search for the user's query and injects the results as context before the model answers. The provider is PLUGGABLE behind a small trait/enum (Tavily as the RECOMMENDED default - purpose-built for LLM/agent search, simple JSON API, free tier - with Brave/SerpAPI addable). The API key is stored via the existing SecretStore/keychain path (like provider keys). A Settings 'Web Search' section sets provider + key (mirroring set_cloud_provider + ProviderKeysSection). CANNOT be verified live in-sandbox (no network): implement cleanly, unit-test request-build + response-parse with mocked HTTP (wiremock, mirroring crates/providers/tests/adapters.rs), gate behind the toggle, and ensure that if unconfigured or on failure the chat STILL proceeds and shows a VISIBLE non-fatal notice (never a silent hang - we just fixed silent failures). Flag clearly that web search needs the user's key + live verification on their build.
steps: Create a web-search abstraction in a host-verifiable crate so it is unit-testable offline (prefer a new module in the `providers` crate, e.g. crates/providers/src/web_search.rs, OR a small new crate crates/web-search; choose providers to reuse its HttpSseClient/reqwest + wiremock test infra). Define a `WebSearchProvider` trait with an async `search(&self, query: &str, opts) -> Result<Vec<WebSearchResult>, WebSearchError>` where WebSearchResult = { title, url, snippet } and WebSearchError is display-safe (never carries the key). Define a `WebSearchKind` enum (Tavily default; scaffold Brave/SerpApi variants). Implement the Tavily provider: POST https://api.tavily.com/search with JSON { api_key, query, max_results }, parse the results array (title/url/content) into WebSearchResult. Build the request against a configurable base_url so wiremock can point it at a local MockServer.

Unit tests (crates/.../tests or inline, using wiremock MockServer exactly like providers/tests/adapters.rs): (a) Tavily request is well-formed (method POST, path /search, body contains query + max_results; assert the key is sent per Tavily's API but NEVER logged); (b) a mocked 200 JSON response parses into the expected WebSearchResult vec; (c) a mocked non-200 / malformed body yields a display-safe WebSearchError; (d) an empty results array yields an empty vec (not an error). No live network.

Persistence: add a `web_search` config to AppConfig (crates/persistence/src/config.rs) as an ADDITIVE #[serde(default)] field, e.g. WebSearchConfig { enabled_provider: Option<WebSearchKind-serialized-string>, max_results: u32 default 5, has_api_key implied by a stored SecretRef under a stable handle }. Keep it forward-compatible (older configs load unchanged via the existing pattern). Add a stable keychain handle constant for the web-search key (e.g. 'web-search-<kind>' or a single 'web-search') stored via SecretStore.store, mirroring set_cloud_provider's secret handling; the key is resolved core-internally at search time and NEVER returned across IPC.

Backend commands (crates/tauri-app/src/commands.rs, each with `_inner`): `set_web_search_provider(kind, apiKey, maxResults?) -> WebSearchConfigView` (validate kind + non-empty key within MAX_SECRET_LEN, store key as SecretRef, persist WebSearchConfig, return display-safe view { kind, hasApiKey, maxResults }); `get_web_search_config() -> WebSearchConfigView | null` (rehydrate, display-safe, never the key); `clear_web_search_provider() -> ()` (delete stored secret + clear config). Register all three in lib.rs generate_handler!. Add _inner unit tests using InMemorySecretStore + in-memory Db (mirror set_cloud_provider tests): set persists + hasApiKey true + key stored; get rehydrates; clear removes secret + config; invalid input rejected.

Wire search into the send path. Add a command `run_web_search(query: String) -> Result<Vec<WebSearchResultView>, CommandError>` (with `_inner`) that loads the WebSearchConfig, resolves the key via SecretStore (core-internal), constructs the configured WebSearchProvider, runs search, and returns display-safe results { title, url, snippet }. It must return a clear CommandError when web search is unconfigured (no provider/key) so the frontend can show a visible non-fatal notice and STILL send the message. Register it, add _inner tests (unconfigured -> error; configured happy path via wiremock-backed provider base_url; provider failure -> display-safe error).

IPC + types: add wrappers (setWebSearchProvider, getWebSearchConfig, clearWebSearchProvider, runWebSearch) in frontend/src/ipc/commands.ts and camelCase TS types in frontend/src/types/index.ts (WebSearchConfigView, WebSearchResultView, a WebSearchKind string-literal union). Keep the mirror exact.

Composer integration (the 🌐 toggle slot from FEAT-002): when the toggle is ON and the user sends, BEFORE calling sendMessage, call runWebSearch(draft). On success, prepend a bounded, clearly-delimited 'Web search results' context block (title + url + snippet per result, size-capped) to the content, then send. On failure OR when unconfigured, show a VISIBLE non-fatal notice (e.g. a role=status line 'Web search unavailable: <reason>. Sending without web results.') and STILL send the plain message (never hang, never silently drop). The toggle state should persist within the conversation/composer session; document that it defaults OFF.

Settings 'Web Search' section: create frontend/src/features/settings/WebSearchSection.tsx mirroring ProviderKeysSection.tsx (provider-kind dropdown with Tavily default, API key password input, optional max-results number input, Save/Clear, rehydrate from getWebSearchConfig on mount). Register it in Settings.tsx SECTIONS (add id 'webSearch' label 'Web Search'). Give every input an explicit aria-label (help-text-wrapping bug guard). The key is stored server-side as an opaque SecretRef and never displayed; the section states web search requires the user's own key and must be verified on their build (since it needs live network).
CSS: reuse settings-form styles; add any minimal composer notice styles via var(--ah-*).

Tests: Rust wiremock + _inner tests as above. Frontend vitest: WebSearchSection saves/clears/rehydrates (mock invoke); composer with toggle ON injects results on success (mock runWebSearch returning results) and shows the non-fatal notice + still sends on failure/unconfigured (mock runWebSearch rejecting). Add the new commands to every mounting test's routeInvoke (settings.test.tsx must mock get_web_search_config; app.test.tsx routeInvoke must handle the new commands) and initialize any new store fields in resets. Use await findBy*/waitFor after state changes.
acceptance_criteria: A WebSearchProvider trait + WebSearchKind enum exist with a working Tavily default implementation, in a host-verifiable crate, unit-tested with wiremock (request-build, response-parse, error, empty) - no live network.
AppConfig carries an additive web_search config; the web-search API key is stored via SecretStore under a stable handle and never returned across IPC.

Commands set_web_search_provider / get_web_search_config / clear_web_search_provider / run_web_search exist with _inner tests, are registered in generate_handler!, and have IPC wrappers + camelCase TS types.
A Settings 'Web Search' section (Tavily default, add/remove/change provider + key + max results) mirrors the Providers & Keys pattern; keys are write-only (never displayed).

The composer 🌐 toggle, when ON, injects web results as context before the model answers; when unconfigured or failing, a VISIBLE non-fatal notice is shown and the message is STILL sent (no silent hang, no silent drop).
Frontend vitest + Rust tests pass; tsc/eslint/prettier clean (or CI-only with exhaustive manual review). Web search's live behavior is clearly flagged as user-only (needs their key + network).

The secret-persistence note is honored: web-search key storage uses the same SecretStore.store path; if the coder observes that set_cloud_provider/set_local_runtime persist to an IN-MEMORY store rather than the OS keychain (the 'no secret found' diagnostic cause), record it as a follow-up in findings without expanding scope.
verification: Run `cargo test -p providers` (or the crate hosting web_search) for the wiremock request/parse/error tests - RUNNABLE in-sandbox if the providers crate builds offline; otherwise CI-only with manual review.
cargo test for the command _inner tests is CI-only (tauri-app needs crates.io) - manual self-review of the command bodies + registration + IPC/type parity + secret handling.
Frontend vitest for WebSearchSection + composer toggle behavior; confirm the non-fatal-notice-and-still-send path. CI-only if node_modules absent, with manual review of mocks and the fallback branch.
Confirm NO code path logs or returns the web-search API key; grep for the key variable to ensure it is only passed to the provider request builder and stored via SecretStore.
